profile.headline: Software Engineer at Apple
profile.summary:
I love diving into the technical weeds to ship something beautiful at scale.

I’m a software engineer working at the intersection of DevOps, MLOps, cloud infrastructure, and full-stack development. I enjoy taking complex engineering problems from idea and architecture through implementation, deployment, and production.

My work spans Kubernetes, AWS, CI/CD, distributed systems, and AI/ML infrastructure, with a growing focus on building tools and systems that make machine learning easier to develop, deploy, and operate.

In my personal time, I’m also interested in Machine Learning Engineering and Research Engineering—building real ML products, evaluating models, experimenting with open-weight models, and understanding the systems that make AI work at scale.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Architect and develop full-stack internal DevOps and MLOps applications that support backend engineering teams across Apple News, Stocks, and Weather.
* Collaborate with backend engineers to diagnose and resolve complex technical and infrastructure issues across CI/CD and deployment pipelines supporting hundreds of microservices.
* Design, operate, and troubleshoot DevOps infrastructure requiring deep technical knowledge of CI/CD systems, Kubernetes, AWS, and Apple’s internal software, infrastructure, and security platforms.
* Produce comprehensive technical documentation, including high-level design documents for new feature proposals, detailed implementation and architecture documentation, and engineering specifications.
* Present technical designs, architecture decisions, new capabilities, and project updates through Keynote presentations to engineering teams and Engineering Program Managers (EPMs).
* Work with Apple’s AI/ML tools, platforms, and services, with hands-on experience integrating MLOps tools into internal engineering applications.
